name: Zalwebtech Order Calendar for WooCommerce
author: onlinedoit

sections.description:
Zalwebtech Order Calendar for WooCommerce helps store managers view and manage WooCommerce orders in a calendar interface directly inside wp-admin.

Plugin website: https://zalwebtech.com/order-calendar-manager-pro/
Pro version: https://zalwebtech.com/order-calendar-manager-pro/

Key features:

  • Calendar view for WooCommerce orders
  • Drag-and-drop order rescheduling
  • Click event action mode: open Edit Order page or Quick Edit popup
  • Quick Edit popup to update order status and add an order note
  • Filter orders by status, payment method, customer, and product
  • Product name search for faster filtering
  • CSV export for filtered results
  • Status-based event colors for better visual tracking
  • New orders badge on the WooCommerce > Order Calendar submenu
  • Local bundled FullCalendar assets with no external CDN dependency

This plugin is intended for WooCommerce-powered stores and works in the admin area.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it via Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate Zalwebtech Order Calendar for WooCommerce from the Plugins screen.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Order Calendar.
  5. (Optional) In Calendar Settings, choose what happens when clicking an event:
    • Open Edit Order Page
    • Open Quick Edit Popup
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Can I change the scheduled date of an order?

Yes. Drag an event to another date in the calendar to update the order schedule.

What fields can be changed in Quick Edit?

You can update order status and add an order note.

Can I export filtered calendar data?

Yes. Use the Export CSV button after applying filters.
